Directions: Read and study the sources about the rights and responsibilities of citizenship. Then use the three sources and your knowledge of social studies to answer each question that follows.
Title: Source 1: Ruby Bridges
Content: In the photograph, Ruby Bridges stands next to a sculpture of herself as a young girl during a ceremony in `text(2014)`. The sculpture marks the day in `text(1960)` when Bridges became the `text(first)` African American to attend the all-white William Frantz Elementary School in New Orleans. Before that, black students and white students had to attend separate schools. The Supreme Court ruled this practice unconstitutional with the `text(1954)` case of Brown v. Board of Education.
